title: El Niño 2026: Sea Surface Temperature Anomaly (2025 vs. 2026) – Updated Daily
description: A side-by-side comparison of sea surface temperature anomalies in the tropical Pacific during 2025 and 2026, highlighting ocean temperature patterns associated with El Niño. This visualization is updated daily to incorporate the latest available data.

datasets.name: Multi-scale Ultra-high Resolution (MUR) Sea Surface Temperature (SST) Analysis
